POCKET.Enable.Name: Enable Pocket Chronicle bridge
POCKET.Enable.Hint: Only the active GM sends approved character and journal data to the phone relay.
POCKET.RelayUrl.Name: Pocket Chronicle app address
POCKET.RelayUrl.Hint: The HTTPS address of your deployed Pocket Chronicle app.
POCKET.CampaignId.Name: Campaign ID
POCKET.CampaignId.Hint: The campaign ID created when this campaign was provisioned.
POCKET.CampaignPassword.Name: Campaign password
POCKET.CampaignPassword.Hint: Create a shared password of at least eight characters for players to request access. This is not your Foundry or administrator password.
POCKET.BridgeKey.Name: Private bridge key
POCKET.BridgeKey.Hint: Keep this secret. Players never need this key.
POCKET.PollMs.Name: Action check interval
POCKET.PollMs.Hint: How often the active GM checks for phone actions, in milliseconds. Five seconds is recommended.
